    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"

V3.1 strengthens this with exact switch silicon, board reference, upstream/downstream fabric path, die-versus-board field and stable BDF/management-source correlation.

original_test_intent: Verify `TEMP_GB_PEX_SW` is the intended GPU-baseboard PCIe switch temperature record and is readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the correct switch/component identity, measurement point, value, units, status and supported thresholds for the platform specification.
original_method: Identify the exact PEX/PCIe switch silicon and board location, bind its PCIe topology identity to the BMC telemetry source, resolve the stable sensor record, and compare complete passive raw/UI fields with the applicable switch die or board-sensor limits under recorded link/load and cooling state. Preserve PCIe, BMC and thermal evidence.
manual_activity: The platform owner identifies the exact PCIe switch, its board and fabric position, BMC telemetry path and temperature measurement point, then supplies field-specific limits. Automation can collect the BMC record, passive topology and UI rows; a human resolves switch/source ambiguity and owns the verdict. No traffic load, link retrain/reset or switch configuration is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and confirmed PEX_SW terminology
Switch vendor/device/part/revision/serial/firmware, board reference designator and physical location
Stable PCIe BDF and upstream/downstream topology to root port, switch ports and GPU/NVSwitch endpoints
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact die, package or nearby-board temperature field
Stable SDR and Dashboard/Server Health identities
Field-specific units, scaling, tolerance, thresholds/hysteresis, status, polling and stale/unavailable rules
Recorded host/GPU power/load, switch/link speed/width/state, fan speeds and baseboard airflow
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser versions and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel/AER, GPU XID, PCIe or thermal logs; they are relevant switch-health context.
Do not accept a value solely because the label exists. Prove the exact switch instance and whether the measurement is switch die/package or a nearby board sensor.
Do not infer topology from one BDF or assume the PEX brand; bind the BMC source to the approved schematic and complete PCIe path.
Treat I2C/I3C/management access as BMC/platform scope; host PCIe enumeration alone does not prove the BMC sensor target or value.
Do not start PCIe/GPU traffic, retrain/reset links, change ASPM/link speed/power, service the board, alter fans/thresholds or flash switch firmware. Record the existing passive state.
Do not rely on the first 100 SDR lines, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on stale data or BMC/UI/topology disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the switch instance, physical/PCIe/BMC-source mapping, measurement point, client and Script; establish the expectation before collection.
Retrieve the full PEX_SW SDR record with identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture the unchanged Dashboard and Server Health entry.
Correlate the record with passive switch inventory and complete upstream/downstream topology plus existing link/load/cooling state; use vendor telemetry only if exact field equivalence is approved.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, traffic load, link retrain/reset, power/service, fan/threshold/firmware change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact PEX/PCIe switch silicon, physical location, topology and BMC management-source map.
Define die-versus-board measurement semantics, thermal limits, tolerance, threshold/status/freshness and any vendor-telemetry equivalence; approve the tool/Script.
Review the single switch sensor evidence and issue the formal verdict without substituting GPU temperature, generic PCIe health or another switch instance.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The named read may retrieve a record, but it is insufficient because it does not establish the switch instance, topology, BMC source or die-versus-board field and its fallback is truncated, credential-exposing and cipher-assumptive.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Confirm the exact switch and BMC telemetry source, query the stable record through protected read-only access, and correlate its complete fields and both UI views with the approved topology and field-specific specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_GB_PEX_SW, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review adds identity evidence without editing Master or manipulating PCIe.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one evidence row keyed by physical PCIe switch, stable topology/BDF and BMC telemetry source, documenting measurement-point semantics and comparing complete raw/API and UI fields with switch-specific limits under recorded passive link/load/cooling state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact GPU-baseboard PCIe-switch topology and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, switch firmware, PCIe/GPU inventory, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: GPU-baseboard schematic/layout, PCIe topology, switch vendor thermal/telemetry specification, BMC management-bus/SDR definition, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact switch, topology and measurement-source binding while preserving the source's passive display check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Temperature display does not validate PCIe link integrity, enumeration, bandwidth, errors, equalization, failover, retraining, switch firmware or alarm/protection behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Switch/topology/BMC-source identity, field-specific acceptance, passive-state timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A platform may expose switch die or nearby board temperature under a similar label; PCIe topology and BDF may vary with population, and UI polling can lag.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or switch-vendor telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/field and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent switch identity, measurement point, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. PCIe enumeration or link status is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and exact switch vendor/device/part/revision/serial/firmware/reference-designator identity
Stable BDF and complete upstream/downstream PCIe topology plus BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact temperature-field source
Complete raw SDR record with stable identity, value, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamp plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health evidence
Switch-specific Project/vendor comparison and recorded host/GPU power/load, link speed/width/state, fan/baseboard airflow with approved telemetry equivalence if any
Explicit stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-traffic/no-retrain-or-reset/no-service/no-retry proof, final PCIe/GPU/BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: PEX_SW and its measurement point are underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation of one switch-associated temperature record. Exact component/source mapping is readiness, not a conflicting purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive PCIe-switch temperature purpose is clear. Project documentation can identify the switch and acceptance field, so missing execution inputs do not make the review permanently BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic PCIe/GPU value or nearby board sensor from being presented as the intended switch temperature, and prevents link load, retraining or reset from being added to a passive display test.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PEX_SW label strongly suggests a PCIe switch but does not identify the device or whether the value is on-die. Because one baseboard can have multiple switches or indirect SMBus routes, the sensor must be bound to silicon, board reference, topology and BMC field. Thermal display evidence cannot establish PCIe functional health.
